description: The image displays two side-by-side pie charts representing the distribution of performance outcomes or error types, associated with the paper "Laying the Foundation First Investigating the Generalization from Atomic Skills to Complex Reasoning Tasks." A single horizontal legend at the top applies to both charts, defining four categories distinguished by varying shades of grey-teal: "Atomic Skill Fail" (darkest shade), "Correct" (medium-dark shade), "Reason Error" (medium-light shade), and "Question Misunderstood" (lightest shade). The left pie chart contains four slices with percentage labels displayed directly inside each segment. Reading clockwise from the top, the slices represent "Atomic Skill Fail" at 12.0%, "Correct" at 68.0%, "Question Misunderstood" at 8.0%, and "Reason Error" at 12.0%. The right pie chart similarly contains four slices with internal percentage labels, showing "Correct" at 55.0%, "Atomic Skill Fail" at 10.0%, "Question Misunderstood" at 14.0%, and "Reason Error" at 21.0% when read clockwise from the top. Both charts feature a subtle 3D shadow effect at their lower edges, but no individual slices are exploded or otherwise visually emphasized. The segments in both charts do not appear to be ordered by descending or ascending size.
